time="0.8s" /> Which only deepened. <break time="0.8s" /> Because no one took it seriously. <break time="0.8s" /> When some kind hearted person suggested. <break time="0.8s" /> That his sadness probably came from hunger. <break time="0.8s" /> The artist might reply. <break time="0.8s" /> Especially late in a fast. <break time="0.8s" /> With a burst of fury. <break time="0.8s" /> Shaking the bars of his cage like an animal. <break time="0.8s" /> The impresario had a way. <break time="0.8s" /> Of handling such outbursts. <break time="0.8s" /> For he would apologize to the audience. <break time="0.8s" /> On the artists behalf. <break time="0.8s" /> Admitting that only the irritability. <break time="0.8s" /> Caused by fasting. <break time="0.8s" /> Which well fed people could hardly understand. <break time="0.8s" /> Could excuse such behavior. <break time="0.8s" /> He would then praise. <break time="0.8s" /> The artists claim. <break time="0.8s" /> That he could fast far longer than forty days. <break time="0.8s" /> While at the same time showing photographs of him. <break time="0.8s" /> On the fortieth day. <break time="0.8s" /> Lying in bed almost dead from exhaustion. <break time="0.8s" /> This twisting of the truth. <break time="0.8s" /> Was more than he could bear. <break time="0.8s" /> For his exhaustion. <break time="0.8s" /> Really the result of being stopped too early. <break time="0.8s" /> Was presented here. <break time="0.8s" /> As the very reason for stopping him. <break time="0.8s" /> To fight against this misunderstanding. <break time="0.8s" /> Against an entire world that refused to understand. <break time="0.8s" /> Was impossible. <break time="0.8s" /> So each time he would sink back. <break time="0.8s" /> Onto the straw with a sigh. <break time="0.8s" /> And the reassured public. <break time="0.8s" /> Could approach the cage once more. <break time="0.8s" /> A few years later, however. <break time="0.8s" /> A sudden change took place. <break time="0.8s" /> For the public that had once crowded to see him. <break time="0.8s" /> Turned away from fasting displays. <break time="0.8s" /> To other amusements. <break time="0.8s" /> And the impresarios tour through Europe. <break time="0.8s" /> Met with indifference everywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> Too old to change his profession. <break time="0.8s" /> And too devoted to fasting to give it up. <break time="0.8s" /> The hunger artist parted from the impresario. <break time="0.8s" /> And hired himself out to a large circus. <break time="0.8s" /> Where his cage was placed. <break time="0.8s" /> Near the animal stables.
